title: [Sutana's Designs, Entry]
description: Interwoven woods in geometric patterns form a marquetry floor that radiates outward from a low, brass-edged pedestal at the center of the room.  Exposed beams and carved zydris trim define the broad, open space with a subtle decagonal outline.  Along one wall, a spiral-columned archway leads into the office, while evenly spaced floor braziers cast a steady glow upward, highlighting the woodwork and illuminating the surrounding walls.
